        HOW IT WORKS
        
    One computer: pick the seat of whoever is at the keyboard. Players join or leave the Stage, applaud each other, and
    the spotlight holder can light Dialogue to invite others into the scene, in character. The GM seat is the Director. Stage is for fun and never changes characters.
